The '''Mission to Rodia''' was a mission during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] carried out by a battalion of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="TCWMobile" />

==Background==
With rumors spreading about a new [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] project in production, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sent entire legions of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to scour the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and investigate. One battalion, that included clone trooper [[Denal/Legends|Denal]], was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="TCWMobile" />

==Ambush==
Soon, the battalion was ambushed and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] destroyed most of their transports. In such harsh conditions, Denal took charge of the battalion and ordered to call for reinforcements. However, the enemy droids were jamming all signals. Hoping to find a way out, Denal ordered his men to form up. Soon, one of the troopers picked up a signal from a [[Separatist comm relay station|communications relay station]]. It was decided to capture it to contact the fleet. After capturing the station and protecting it against droid counter attacks, the clones were able to contact the Republic fleet, that sent a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunship to pick them up.<ref name="TCWMobile" />

==Later actions==
Denal was later assigned to clear a jungle clearing of droids in order to make way for Republic reinforcements, which he successfully completed.<ref name="TCWMobile" />

==Appearances==
